title: API Overage Billing & Calculations
content: API overages are billed at $0.05 per 1,000 requests beyond the included 100,000 base monthly units. Plan discounts (e.g. Agency 20% discount) apply exclusively to the base recurring platform subscription, not to variable infrastructure overages.

title: Annual Renewal & Refund Policy
content: Annual subscription renewals are eligible for a full refund within 14 calendar days of billing, provided that API utilization during the renewed cycle does not exceed 5% of monthly allocation. All refund and credit authorizations require approval by the Senior Finance Operations team and cannot be dispatched automatically.

title: Production Incidents & High-Severity SLA
content: Production severity 1 incidents (gateway outage, total service failure) trigger high-priority alerts to on-call infrastructure engineering. Guaranteed SLA acknowledgment is within 15 minutes. Real-time incident telemetry is published to status.orbit-ai.com.

title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Reset Workflow
content: To reset two-factor authentication when a device is lost, the account owner must provide an unhashed backup code or complete an authorized video identity challenge. Support agents cannot bypass 2FA via plain email requests due to SOC-2 Type II security requirements.

title: GDPR and Account Deletion Protocol
content: GDPR erasure and account termination requests require formal escalation to the Data Protection Officer (DPO). Data is purged within 30 days following cryptographic signature verification of the account holder's identity.
